summary: The candidate shares deletion cleanup work across authority instances and coalesces replays by keyId/localOwner. Completion is still published only inside the transaction after awaited cleanup settles, and the supplied concurrent-cleanup regression remains present.

evidence: src/authority/native-authority-principals.ts:56-63 adds a WeakMap keyed by the shared control sources object, and lines 76-78 assign its work map to every authority instance using those sources.

src/authority/native-authority-principals.ts:518-527 now keys in-flight cleanup by keyId/localOwner, so concurrent replays of one deletion join the same promise rather than starting independent cleanup.
